column4: A single small video-game marker icon that floats over a building, in the chunky pixel-art style of a 1990s Build-engine game like Blood or Redneck Rampage: an old straw broom with a wooden handle, tilted, sweeping a little grey puff of dust, bold dark outline, a few flat muted colours, readable at a tiny size, centred and filling most of the frame, on a solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background. No text, no letters, no shadow, no frame.

A single small video-game marker icon that floats over a building, in the chunky pixel-art style of a 1990s Build-engine game like Blood or Redneck Rampage: a neatly folded stack of white bed linen, a sheet and a pillowcase with a faded blue check, seen a little from above, bold dark outline, a few flat muted colours, readable at a tiny size, centred and filling most of the frame, on a solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background. No text, no letters, no shadow, no frame.

Pixel-art texture in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage): a flat orthographic straight-on view, chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, slightly grimy. A single small cheap white plastic shop door sign of the kind that hung behind the glass of a village shop door in 1990s Czechoslovakia: a landscape rectangle with rounded corners, a thin red border line inset from the edge, the face completely BLANK with no text at all, the plastic yellowed with age, scuffed, a fly speck or two, hanging from a short thin brass chain going up from both top corners to one small hook at the top centre. It fills about 85 percent of the canvas, centred. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around the sign and inside the chain loop, no shadow, no text, no letters, no frame, no watermark.
